keySentence: A frog came up and spoke to her.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The frog sat by the well. He could find the ball. He wanted something. A frog came up and spoke to her.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The frog sat on the edge of the well and smiled. A frog came up and spoke to her about the golden ball. He said he could dive deep and bring it back. But the frog wanted something in return. The princess listened carefully to the little frog. She was willing to do anything to get her ball back.
facts.Word cards: princess = 공주 / golden = 황금색의 / dropped = 떨어뜨렸다 / precious = 소중한
